answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging a verifiable delay function to establish a trellis of trusted identities, thereby rendering cloning computationally infeasible. By utilizing a thread of sequential delay functions, honest agents maintain a bridge between reputation updates and verifiable randomness, ensuring information-theoretic unforgeability. This construction enables Byzantine fault tolerance, guaranteeing cryptographic finality and preventing identity spoofing.
